purpose: SeqSeg is a Slicer module for seed-based vessel (aorta, coronary, etc.) segmentation. It installs the PyPI `seqseg` package and nnU-Net, downloads pretrained weights from Zenodo, and runs the `seqseg` CLI as a subprocess to produce a segmentation.
summary: I read the full module, the CMake files and the catalog entry; I did not open the README beyond a search. The code is not malicious. Network use is limited to PyPI and Zenodo. The main problems are the following. (1) `build_dependencies` is empty although CMake declares `EXTENSION_DEPENDS` of PyTorch and NNUNet. (2) The module silently downgrades NumPy and force-pins torch 2.2.2. (3) The `seqseg` package, with its dependencies, is installed from PyPI without confirmation. (4) The Zenodo weights are downloaded without a checksum. (5) The subprocess runs on the GUI thread, and the CLI is called by bare name. These need fixes but none is a deliberate harm.
not_checked: <parameter name="x">Contents of the PyPI `seqseg` package, its dependency requirements and license; Zenodo archive contents and license; seqseg.ui; the README (only searched); actual runtime behavior in Slicer.
